result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated mid-letter as 'Tokumaru Ramer' due to layout crowding with the rating.

issues.description: Restaurant name under 'Popular right now' is clipped mid-character, displayed as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final letter cut off to make room for the rating on the same line, with no ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title-rating layout to prevent mid-character clipping - allow flexible width, wrap to next line, or truncate with ellipsis so the full name is readable.
